sections.Profile:
"Shoot 'n Scoot," released by Multimorphic in 2020, is an add-on game for the P3 Pinball Platform that integrates physical pinball mechanics with a vertically scrolling on-screen adventure. Players guide their on-screen character or vehicle left or right by making precise shots on the physical playfield, aiming to collect items and avoid obstacles across various themed environments. The game is compatible with all available playfield modules on the P3 platform.

- Manufacturer: Multimorphic
- Years made: 2020
- In production: yes
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
